ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.4 Playtest adds explicit Butter++ coexistence. RimMT detects Butter++ split-tick state, samples TickManagerUpdate slices instead of measuring a logical DoSingleTick across multiple rendered frames, and defers worker-to-main-thread callback commits while Butter++ is mid-tick. AdaptiveTPS remains supported as a separate pacing mode. Butter++ itself declares AdaptiveTPS and Dubs Performance Analyzer incompatible, so those external combinations are reported rather than treated as safe. Path workers continue using immutable snapshots with vanilla PawnPath authoritative while production path-cost parity is tightened.
